Subject: Major latency spike + 5xx during holiday promo — urgent

Neha —

We hit a large degradation this morning during our 10AM PST promo window. Latency spiked from 120ms p95 to ~1.8s and we saw a ~6% 5xx rate on the model route for checkout recommendations. This materially impacted our conversions for the hour — estimating ~4x worse than baseline. Engineering pulled logs and we captured multiple KV cache misses and OOMs on the inference nodes; attaching the heap dump.

We need:
- A short RCA and immediate mitigation plan by EOD PT
- A timeline for permanent fixes and any credits/financial relief
- Weekly follow-ups with our execs until this is fully closed

Samir
Head of Engineering, QuickMart

Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Major latency spike + 5xx during holiday promo — urgent

Quick update from infra triage (notes pulled from on-call):
- Observed repeated KV-store eviction cascade on pool A (region us-west2). Several inference hosts experienced rapid GC spikes leading to OOM restarts; these correlate with the 10:03–10:38 window.
- A recent model variant (v202701) introduced a slightly larger KV schema and increased transient memory usage under heavy prefix fanout patterns.
- Autoscale policies were saturated; scale-up lagged behind the sustained surge due to concurrent maintenance windows on two nodes.

Immediate mitigations executed at 10:47 PST (post your report):
- reverted traffic away from v202701 to v202612 stable variant (drop-in config).
- increased burst capacity pool for QuickMart for the remainder of the promo window.
- applied temporary route-level circuit-breaker to fail fast on backend saturation (reduced 5xx rate).

Next actions (owners):
- Karthik: full heap comparison and patch proposal for KV schema (ETA 48h).
- Grace: run load replay against v202701 with larger simulated prefixes (~24h).
- Neha: coordinate exec readout and credit ask with Lisa/Samir (EOD).

I attached the initial digests and heap analysis to the internal ticket.

—Karthik
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Lisa / Samir —

Short executive summary for your CFO/ops review:
- Impact: 10:03–10:38 PST on 2027-02-16; elevated p95 latency (~1.8s) and ~6% 5xx rate on the checkout recommendation route.
- Root cause (prelim): memory pressure from KV schema changes in model v202701 + concurrent node maintenance resulting in slower autoscale.
- Mitigation taken: immediate rollback to v202612, increased burst capacity, route circuit-breaker. Incident rate and latency are back to baseline.

Deliverables we will provide:
- Short RCA note and slide deck (attached) — by EOD PT today.
- Patch to address KV schema memory behavior and a test plan (48h).
- Postmortem runbook update and a high-availability configuration for your account (5 business days).
- Proposed credit for the affected window; sample calculation attached.

Weekly cadence proposal: 30-min sync every Thursday for 4 weeks (Ops + Execs). Please confirm availability or suggest alternatives.

We also opened INF-8421 for the engineering work and linked our public status page for transparency.

—Neha
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
